title: Approvals ledger - three approvals per build (Fable, external auditor, Kumar). A build may be called DONE only when all three are true.
rule: A flag may be true ONLY when <flag>_evidence is a relative FILE path under docs/audit_pack_041126/ (not artifacts/) or an AUDITOR_RESPONSES-style folder, not code / CLAUDE.md / this ledger, that names the build's path, and <flag>_evidence_sha256 holds its sha256. Then run `python3 tools/requirements_guard.py --accept-state` to append the approval to docs/framework/APPROVALS_STATE.json (append-only hash chain). The guard rejects anything else, a removed row, a changed evidence file, and any claimed_status DONE/COMPLETE/COMPLETED/GREEN/PROVEN/APPROVED without all three accepted. LIMIT: a local guard cannot stop someone who edits ledger, evidence, hash and chain together; the real gate is Kumar plus the external auditor.
